title: Lepro LED Headlamp 320014 — USB-C, 6 Modes, Red Light, IPX4
short_description: Lepro LED headlamp with a USB-C rechargeable battery, 6 light modes, red light and IPX4 — only 77 g, for camping and jogging.
long_description: According to the product title, the Lepro LED headlamp (model 320014) is rechargeable via USB-C and offers 6 light modes and a red light. According to the item description it has an IPX4 rating. The runtime is stated as 15 hours according to Amazon. It has a lithium-ion battery, a head mount with headband, measures 6.3 x 4.5 x 3.5 cm and weighs 77.1 g. The warranty is 24 months according to Amazon. Amazon lists camping, fishing and jogging among the recommended uses. The brightness figures on the Amazon page are not entirely consistent, so please check the manufacturer's exact details on the Amazon product page before buying.
